positive_cases.name: php_worker_spawns_shell
positive_cases.scenario: Application worker process spawns a shell.
positive_cases.rationale: Parent and child selections both match.

positive_cases.name: web_server_spawns_bash
positive_cases.scenario: Web server process spawns an interactive shell.
positive_cases.rationale: Parent and child selections both match.

negative_cases.name: web_server_spawns_logrotate
negative_cases.scenario: Web server invokes its log rotation helper.
negative_cases.rationale: Parent matches but the child is not a shell.

negative_cases.name: session_shell
negative_cases.scenario: Interactive login shell started by the session manager.
negative_cases.rationale: Child matches but the parent is not a web service.

negative_cases.name: cron_spawns_shell
negative_cases.scenario: Scheduler runs a maintenance shell script.
negative_cases.rationale: Child matches but the parent is the scheduler, covered by another rule.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
